recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core source follow-up is recommended for FHIR-17635; if duplicate expansion rows recur, investigate terminology expansion tooling or generated publication output rather than changing the current use-context ValueSet definition.
issue_request: FHIR-17635 reported that valueset-use-context.html contained duplicate codes in the rendered expansion. The Jira issue is Published, resolution Persuasive, applied for STU3, and its comment records svn revision 14576 as the application.
initial_application: Git commit 8a424ffcc6b1cf70bba4af7e5221930a2f6ca51e is the git-svn import of svn revision 14576. It changed ValueSetExpanderSimple and regenerated vscache/-1232820885.json for ValueSet/use-context from 2,682 rows with 1,682 duplicate system/code pairs to 1,000 unique rows with no duplicates.
additional_context: The current active source for the value set is source/terminologies/valueset-use-context.xml, referenced by source/terminologies/bindings.xml and source/datatypes/usagecontext.xml. FHIR-20373 later removed a duplicate urn:iso:std:iso:3166 compose include from the same current source and is already represented on the combined branch. The archival tools/history/release3/valuesets.xml still reflects old STU3 compose data, but no active current build configuration reference was found for editing it as part of this reconciliation.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source change was needed because the original duplicate expansion was already fixed by the recorded application, and the current source contains 13 compose includes with zero exact duplicate include keys and exactly one urn:iso:std:iso:3166 include.

related_jiras.note: Later Published issue removed a duplicate ISO3166 include from source/terminologies/valueset-use-context.xml and is already audited on the combined branch.
